== Description ==
Original Japanese [[Motti Seeker (Japanese)|Motti Seeker]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], black-border printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

== Source and credit ==
Photograph of the physical card from the SWCCG Cards shop listing ''Motti Seeker (Japanese)'', <code>https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-anh-bb-ls-motti-seeker/</code> (now returns Page not found). Preserved copy of the listing: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260611194442/https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-anh-bb-ls-motti-seeker/ Internet Archive] (11 June 2026; page title and image link checked). Original image: [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_anh_bb_ls_Motti_Seeker.png jpn_anh_bb_ls_Motti_Seeker.png] (851 × 1200 PNG, Last-Modified 26 January 2022 21:00:22 GMT, SHA-256 <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">73c12aa78788df1ab7982f978b0c58f4c910e7bc759717b5862c1319a605069d</code>); no Wayback copy of the image itself yet.
